newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium to clamp down on blank ID card thefts.
newsitem.headline: Belgium to clamp down on blank ID card thefts.

text.p: The Belgian government said on Friday it would clamp down on the theft of blank passports and other identity cards from local administrations.
In a statement, the government said 50,000 blank passports, identity cards for foreigners and driving licences have been stolen from town halls since January 1994.
The local authorities are responsible for issuing foreigners with residence permits.
